title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 21: Jehoram's evil reign, Elijah's letter, and his painful death.

questions.text: Why did Jehoshaphat give the kingdom to Jehoram?
questions.explanation: Jehoshaphat gave his other sons gifts and fortified cities, but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram because he was the firstborn.

answers.text: Because he was the strongest warrior
Because the people asked for him

questions.text: What did Jehoram do once he had strengthened himself over the kingdom?
questions.explanation: When Jehoram had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

answers.text: He rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem
He killed all his brothers with the sword
He made a covenant with Yahweh
He gave his riches to the Levites

questions.text: Whose daughter did Jehoram have as his wife?
questions.explanation: Jehoram walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab's house, for he had Ahab's daughter as his wife.

questions.text: Why would Yahweh not destroy David's house in Jehoram's days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh would not destroy David's house because of the covenant he had made with David, and his promise to give a lamp to him and his children always.

answers.text: Because of the covenant he had made with David
Because the people of Judah fasted

questions.text: Which town also revolted from under Jehoram's hand at the same time as Edom?
questions.explanation: Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.

questions.text: From whom did a letter come to Jehoram?
questions.explanation: A letter came to Jehoram from Elijah the prophet.

questions.text: What sickness did the letter say Jehoram would have?
questions.explanation: The letter said he would have great sickness with a disease of his bowels, until his bowels fell out day by day.

questions.text: Whose spirit did Yahweh stir up against Jehoram?
questions.explanation: Yahweh stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians.

questions.text: Which of Jehoram's sons was left after the invaders carried away his sons?
questions.explanation: There was no son left him, except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

questions.text: How does verse 20 describe Jehoram's departure?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says he departed without being missed, and they buried him in David's city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

answers.text: All Israel mourned him seven days
He was buried among the kings
The people made a great burning for him
